correctness.rationale: Checked the precise query universe of all nonempty proper Boolean subsets and hypotheses as permutations encoded by prefix-subset membership. All-positive shattering forces comparable sets. Conversely for any labelled inclusion chain each segment between positive landmarks can be ordered to avoid all nested negative prefixes by placing one element outside the largest forbidden prefix first. This creates all binary traces. Ordered set partitions into k+1 blocks give (k+1)! S(n,k+1), which is the face count of the proper Boolean order complex; the h-transform is the classical Eulerian polynomial. Conditioned on a positive response at A, the hypothesis family factors into independent prefix concepts inside A and its complement, giving Ldim <= n-1 by product-additivity and induction; a maximal chain support provides the matching VC lower bound. Independently enumerated every shattered support and computed adaptive query depth for n=1..4, yielding face arrays [1], [1,2], [1,6,6], [1,14,36,24] and Ldim 0,1,2,3.
